mechanism: Darunavir is a CYP3A4 inhibitor that may increase chlorthalidone levels; chlorthalidone-induced hypokalemia and hyponatremia may be exacerbated by altered electrolyte handling with protease inhibitor use.
action: Monitor electrolytes (potassium, sodium) regularly; consider potassium supplementation or alternative antihypertensive; assess blood pressure control during concurrent therapy.
